020import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageByEntityEvent;
021import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEntityEvent;
022import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
023import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
024
025/**
026 * InteractionType
027 *
028 * @author creatorfromhell
029 * @since 6.2.0.11
030 */
031public interface InteractionType {
032
033  /**
034   * Retrieves the identifier associated with this type of interaction.
035   *
036   * @return The identifier for this type of interaction.
037   */
038  String identifier();
039
040  /**
041   * Checks if this type of interaction applies to the given PlayerInteractEvent with the specified
042   * InteractionClick action.
043   *
044   * @param event The PlayerInteractEvent to check against.
045   * @param click The type of interaction click to consider.
046   *
047   * @return True if this interaction type applies to the event with the given InteractionClick,
048   * false otherwise.
049   */
050  boolean applies(final @NotNull PlayerInteractEvent event, final @NotNull InteractionClick click);
051
052  /**
053   * Determines if this type of interaction applies to the given PlayerInteractEntityEvent
054   * with the specified InteractionClick type.
055   *
056   * @param event The PlayerInteractEntityEvent to evaluate. Must not be null.
057   * @param click The type of interaction click to consider. Must not be null.
058   * @return True if this interaction type applies to the event with the given InteractionClick,
059   * false otherwise.
060   */
061  default boolean applies(final @NotNull PlayerInteractEntityEvent event, final @NotNull InteractionClick click) {
062    return false;
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Determines if this type of interaction applies to the given EntityDamageByEntityEvent with the specified
067   * InteractionClick action.
068   * @param event The EntityDamageByEntityEvent to check against. Must not be null.
069   * @param click The type of interaction click to consider. Must not be null.
070   * @return True if this interaction type applies to the event with the given InteractionClick, false otherwise.
071   */
072  default boolean applies(final @NotNull EntityDamageByEntityEvent event, final @NotNull InteractionClick click) {
073    return false;
074  }
075}
